## About Fincomm Solutions Private Limited

Data last updated: 11 March 2026

Fincomm Solutions Private Limited is a private limited company based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. It specialises in advisory services, a part of the broader financial services sector. Incorporated on 27 December 2010, the company has been in operation for over 16 years.

Registered with ROC Mumbai under CIN U74120MH2010PTC211383.

Capital: an authorised share capital of ₹1 Lakh and a paid-up capital of ₹1 Lakh. It is led by directors Shilpa Rajiv Bengali and Rajiv Bipin Bengali.

Last AGM: 30 September 2025. Financial statements filed for year ended 31 March 2025. Office: 517 The Summit Business Park M V Road, Off Gundavli Village Opp Pvr Cinema Andheri East Mumbai, Maharashtra, India – 400093.

As per the financials filed for FY 2025, the company reported a revenue of ₹17.5 Lakh, a decline of 6% compared to the previous year.

The current compliance status is marked as compliant by the Registrar of Companies.
